subject: Private hosting qualification and milestones for LumenCatalyst
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumencatalyst.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Private hosting discovery - next steps

Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Highlights from the call:
- Primary driver: regulatory residency + control for PHI-related inference — LumenCatalyst requires US-only hosting and an air-gapped option for certain customers.
- Pain: current vendor APIs and model hosts don't meet data egress controls nor provide audit-ready logs for device telemetry.
- Goals: production-grade inference behind a VPC (or on-prem) with KMS integration, 30 ms p95 for inference for the 512-token path, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Ops constraints: limited outbound IPs (strict egress firewall), procurement needs vendor risk questionnaire completed w/in 3 weeks, and procurement target is Jan 2027 kickoff.

What we propose next (concrete):
1) We'll share a short readiness matrix (attached) showing the path for three hosting options: Hosted w/ VPC peering, Dedicated (Redwood-managed reserved capacity), and On-prem package.
2) Provide SOC2 report + standard security artifact pack to your SecOps (cc'd) by end of week.
3) Tech follow-up: schedule a 60-minute deep-dive with your network/security team to walk egress controls, IP allowlist, and any cert requirements.
4) Procurement: draft SOW + estimated commercial cadence for Dedicated/On-prem (Ben will follow up on pricing).

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261213.pdf (call notes), onprem-readiness-matrix.xlsx

Next steps I'm proposing right now:
- Asha, can you confirm best time for the secops deep-dive (we're available Tues/Wed PST)?
- If you can share the vendor risk questionnaire or specific procurement template, we'll populate it and return within 48 hours.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Asha Rao <asha@lumencatalyst.com>

Cc: secops@lumencatalyst.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 17:10:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Private hosting discovery - next steps

Priya — thanks for the crisp recap. All points captured. A couple of clarifications and asks:

- Timeline: procurement intends to start vendor review the week of Jan 10; we'd like an SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) and attestation materials before that review.
- Network: our SecOps requires an inbound/outbound port matrix and the static IPs you'd expect for egress. Can you provide that list and any NAT/Gateway expectations?
- Air-gap: not every customer will need a fully air-gapped deployment — but we do need a vetted path for one customer segment. The readiness matrix's on-prem column will be important.

I've looped in SecOps (secops@lumencatalyst.com) — they'll coordinate availability. Tentative availability for the deep-dive: Wed 2026-12-16 afternoon PST or Thu 2026-12-17 morning PST.

We will also share the vendor risk questionnaire (VRQ) tomorrow; please return the completed VRQ to procurement@lumencatalyst.com within 48 hours of receipt.

Best,
Asha
Head of Product | LumenCatalyst
asha@lumencatalyst.com

Hi Asha / Priya — Monica from Customer Success here. Appreciate the context — a few operational notes so the SecOps call is productive:

1) Pre-call checklist (what we'll circulate before the technical deep dive):
   - High-level network diagram (customer side)
   - Expected egress IP allowlist / firewall rules
   - KMS provider (customer-managed?) and any HSM requirements
   - Whether logs need to be forwarded to your collector (Syslog/EFK) or held in Redwood audit logs only

2) Onboarding milestones we typically follow for on-prem/VPC
   - Week 0: Kickoff + NOC/SecOps deep-dive
   - Week 1: Network allowlist validation + cert exchange
   - Week 2: Proof-of-concept (small model, limited tokens) deployed in staging
   - Week 3–4: Performance tuning and SLA ramp

3) For air-gapped customers we've done:
   - Staged artifact handoff (model bundles + runtime) with a signed transfer manifest
   - Offline attestation docs and on-site or remote install support (ops hours estimated separately)

We have a short readiness matrix attached (onprem-readiness-matrix.xlsx) that maps the above to owners and risks.

If Wed 12/16 afternoon PST works for SecOps, we'll send a calendar invite and a pre-call packet.

Cheers,
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai
